mirror.rule: NIFTY rows before 2024-01-01, without 2023-11-12 (index/future/option); daily bars before 2024-01-01

decisions.2023-03-01: ICICI returned no option candle for this whole session: 23 two-day requests held only Feb 28 and 4 one-day requests were empty. The session stays and the book cannot enter on it. No candle is invented.
decisions.2023-11-12: The Muhurat hour is not a session here, as in 2024 and 2025.
decisions.bad rows: Kept as they are, as in the other years: replays read the bid and ask derived from each close, and a negative volume only matters to volume readings.
decisions.lot: 65, today's contract, as in every other year, although 2023's real lot was 50. Rupee figures are comparable across years, not what 2023's traders earned.
decisions.candles: The same declared candle model as 2024-26: bid and ask from the archive's p75 spread, about Rs 100-200 per trade per lot optimistic, with the extra cost in the money path.
decisions.stray bars: Index bars from 09:15 to 15:39 kept as exported, as in the other years.
decisions.expiries: Thursday all year, holiday shifts worked out from the real sessions. The probe proved Jan 25, 2023 and the year-end Jan 4 and Jan 25, 2024.
